viewport-fit=cover">

rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/*
==========================================================================
TERQYN HQ — canonical stylesheet (corporate flagship redesign, consolidated)
Institutional / editorial / parent-holding-company. Not TERQYN SYSTEMS.
Palette: bone + ink, oxblood primary, aged brass secondary.
Branch colors appear only as small identifiers (dots, marks, meters).
==========================================================================
*/
:root{
--bg:#F1EFE9;--panel:#F8F6F1;--panel2:#E8E3D8;--text:#151516;--mute:#66645F;--line:rgba(21,21,22,.14);
--accent:#641F2B;--brass:#9A7A49;--neg:#A33C35;--void:#0A0A0B;
--shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(23,20,17,.10);
--serif:'Bodoni Moda','Didot','Bodoni 72',Georgia,serif;
--sans:'Hanken Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
--bar:82px;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
--bg:#0C0C0D;--panel:#131314;--panel2:#1B1A1A;--text:#EEEAE0;--mute:#A19C92;--line:rgba(238,234,224,.13);
--accent:#A44C5B;--brass:#C2A06A;--neg:#D96D63;--shadow:0 30px 90px
rgba(0,0,0,.34);}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
--bg:#0C0C0D;--panel:#131314;--panel2:#1B1A1A;--text:#EEEAE0;--mute:#A19C92;--line:rgba(238,234,224,.13);
--accent:#A44C5B;--brass:#C2A06A;--neg:#D96D63;--shadow:0 30px 90px
rgba(0,0,0,.34);}
@media (max-width:560px){:root{--bar:74px}}

/* ---------- foundation ---------- */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
body{margin:0;position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-height:100%;color:var(--text);font:16px/1.6
var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.004em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 8%,color-mix(in
srgb,var(--brass) 4.5%,transparent) 8% calc(8% + 1px),transparent calc(8% +
1px)),var(--bg)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse 48% 38% at 96% 4%,color-mix(in
srgb,var(--brass) 7%,transparent),transparent 68%),
radial-gradient(ellipse 42% 32% at 2% 96%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent)
5%,transparent),transparent 72%)}
body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.28;
background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0
31px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 3%,transparent) 31px 32px);
-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 12%,#000
88%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000
12%,#000 88%,transparent)}
a{color:inherit}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
img,svg{max-width:100%}
::selection{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent)
24%,transparent);color:var(--text)}
:focus-visible{outline:1px solid
var(--brass);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:0}
.wrap{max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:clamp(22px,4vw,64px)}
.serif{font-family:var(--serif)}
.mute{color:var(--mute)}
.small{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;margin:0;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--text)}
.h1{font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,86px);line-height:.98}
.h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,56px);line-height:1.02}
.h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,29px)}
.lede{font-size:clamp(17px,1.55vw,20px);line-height:1.7;max-width:58ch;color:var(--mute);margin:22px
0 0}
p{max-width:70ch}
.section{padding:clamp(72px,8vw,118px) 0}
.section+.section{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.page-head{position:relative;padding:clamp(84px,10vw,150px) 0
56px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.page-head::before{content:"TERQYN / HEADQUARTERS";display:block;margin-bottom:24px;color:var(--brass);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em}
.page-head.row::before{flex-basis:100%;margin-bottom:12px}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;background:color-mix(in
srgb,var(--bg) 94%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)
saturate(110%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px)
saturate(110%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:var(--bar);gap:20px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.brand svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.brand svg circle:first-child{stroke:var(--brass)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.nav a:not(.btn){position:relative;text-decoration:none;padding:12px
14px;color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.03em}
.nav
a:not(.btn)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:6px;height:1px;background:var(--brass);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform
.25s ease}
.nav a:not(.btn):hover,.nav a.on{color:var(--text)}
.nav a:not(.btn):hover::after,.nav a.on::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.nav .btn{margin-left:10px}
.menu-btn,.theme-btn{display:none;background:transparent;border:1px solid
var(--line);border-radius:0;width:42px;height:42px;cursor:pointer}
.theme-btn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;margin-left:6px}
.menu-btn:hover,.theme-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brass)}
@media (max-width:920px){
.menu-btn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center}
.nav{position:absolute;top:var(--bar);left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px
solid var(--line);padding:16px 24px 28px;display:none}
.nav.open{display:flex}
.nav a:not(.btn){padding:14px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav a:not(.btn)::after{display:none}
.nav .btn{margin:16px 0 0}
.theme-btn{margin:12px 0 0}
}

/* ---------- buttons / chips / tags ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:11px
18px;border-radius:0;border:1px solid
var(--line);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.035em;white-space:nowrap;transition:background
.2s ease,border-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,transform .2s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:var(--brass)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--text);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--text)}
.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.accent{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn.sm{min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:12px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn[disabled]:hover{transform:none;border-color:var(--line)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.chip{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:0;border:1px solid
var(--line);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.035em;color:var(--mute)}
.chip:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--brass)}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px
9px;border-radius:0;border:1px solid
var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--mute);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.055em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.tag
.dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c,var(--accent))}
/* status: positive reads as settled ink, caution as brass, problems as red
— kept distinct from the oxblood brand accent */
.tag.good{color:var(--text);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text)
40%,transparent)}
.tag.warn{color:var(--brass);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brass)
45%,transparent)}
.tag.bad{color:var(--neg);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--neg)
45%,transparent)}

/* ---------- surfaces ---------- */
.panel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,36px);border:1px
solid
var(--line);border-radius:0;background:var(--panel);transition:border-color
.24s ease}
.panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:42px;height:2px;background:var(--brass);opacity:.8}
.panel:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brass) 36%,var(--line))}
.panel.tight{padding:22px}
.grid{display:grid;gap:18px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media
(max-width:900px){.g3,.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (max-width:620px){.g2,.g3,.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.between{justify-content:space-between}
.stack>*+*{margin-top:12px}
hr.rule{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:28px 0}
/* hairline-ruled grids: cells share borders, empty cells stay clean */
.offer-list,.leaders,.steps,.kpis{border:0;background:none;gap:0}
.offer-list>li,.leaders>.person,.steps>li,.kpis>.kpi{border:1px solid
var(--line);margin:0 -1px -1px 0}

/* ---------- forms ---------- */
label.f{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.045em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
label.f>span{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.inp{width:100%;min-height:45px;padding:11px
13px;border-radius:0;border:1px solid
var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--text);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;font-weight:400}
select.inp{background:var(--bg)}
.inp:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brass) 55%,var(--line))}
.inp:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--brass);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px
color-mix(in srgb,var(--brass) 10%,transparent)}
textarea.inp{min-height:96px;resize:vertical}
.search{max-width:340px}

/* ---------- tables ---------- */
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0}
table.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px;min-width:620px}
.tbl th{text-align:left;padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid
var(--line);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel2)
56%,transparent);color:var(--mute);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tbl td{padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl tr.click{cursor:pointer}
.tbl tr.click:hover td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brass)
6%,transparent)}

/*
==========================================================================
HOME — monumental, editorial
==========================================================================
*/
.hero{position:relative;min-height:calc(100svh -
var(--bar));display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:clamp(84px,12vh,150px)
0 58px;overflow:hidden}
.hero>.wrap{width:100%}
.hero::before{content:"TERQYN / PARENT HOLDING COMPANY";position:absolute;top:42px;left:max(24px,calc((100vw - 1380px)/2 +
64px));color:var(--mute);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em}
.hero-rings{position:absolute;right:-8%;top:42%;width:min(720px,78vw);transform:translateY(-50%)
rotate(-8deg);opacity:.42;pointer-events:none}
.hero-rings circle{fill:none;stroke:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text)
12%,transparent);stroke-width:1}
.hero-rings
.draw{stroke:var(--brass);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:1400;stroke-dashoffset:1400;animation:draw
2.4s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1) .2s forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
.wordmark{position:relative;margin:0;max-width:9ch;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(86px,15vw,222px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.065em}
.wordmark::after{content:"";display:block;width:min(580px,72vw);height:1px;margin-top:38px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--brass),transparent)}
.wordmark
sup{position:relative;top:1em;vertical-align:top;margin-left:12px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--brass)}
.tagline{position:relative;margin:26px 0
0;max-width:34ch;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);line-height:1.3;color:var(--mute)}
.index{margin-top:72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.index a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,.9fr)
minmax(0,1.6fr)
auto;align-items:center;gap:24px;min-height:88px;padding:22px
0;border-bottom:1px solid
var(--line);text-decoration:none;transition:padding .28s ease,background
.28s ease}
.index
a:hover{padding-left:18px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in
srgb,var(--accent) 7%,transparent),transparent 52%)}
.index
.nm{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(23px,2.2vw,34px);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.index .ds{max-width:52ch;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--mute)}
.index
.go{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid
var(--line);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s}
.index a:hover .go{border-color:var(--brass);color:var(--brass)}
.index a.lead .nm{color:var(--accent)}
.index a.lead
.go{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.domains{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px
24px;margin-top:30px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid
var(--line);color:var(--mute);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.domains
button{background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;text-transform:inherit;font-weight:inherit}
.domains button:hover{color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:700px){
.hero{min-height:auto;padding-top:118px}
.hero::before{left:24px}
.hero-rings{right:-48%;top:28%;width:120vw;opacity:.28}
.wordmark{font-size:clamp(72px,22vw,118px)}
.index a{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:6px 16px;min-height:100px}
.index .ds{grid-column:1}
.index .go{grid-row:1/3;grid-column:2}
}

/*
==========================================================================
ECOSYSTEM — portfolio of operating companies
==========================================================================
*/
.eco-head{padding:clamp(100px,12vw,170px) 0 48px;border-bottom:1px solid
var(--line)}
.eco-head::before{content:"PORTFOLIO / OPERATING COMPANIES";display:block;margin-bottom:22px;color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em}
.eco-head .h1{max-width:10ch;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.eco-head .lede{margin:22px 0 0;max-width:56ch}
/* 12-col portfolio. Rows tile as 7|5, 5|7 … so the hairline grid never
shows a hole; an odd last company spans the full row. */
.portal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;padding:0;margin:0
0 110px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0}
.portal{grid-column:span
7;position:relative;min-height:360px;padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--panel);cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;transition:background
.24s ease}
.portal:nth-child(4n+2),.portal:nth-child(4n+3){grid-column:span 5}
.portal:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}
.portal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -20% -48%
auto;width:58%;aspect-ratio:1;opacity:.12;background:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in
srgb,var(--c) 26%,transparent),transparent 70%);transition:opacity .4s}
.portal:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel) 92%,var(--panel2))}
.portal:hover::before{opacity:.26}
.portal .ap-wrap{width:84px;margin:0 0 38px;opacity:.78}
.portal .aperture .mono{font-size:42px}
.portal
.p-for{color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.portal
.p-name{max-width:10ch;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.portal .p-desc{max-width:48ch;margin:6px 0
18px;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px;line-height:1.65}
.portal
.p-foot{margin-top:auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px
solid var(--line);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.035em;color:var(--mute)}
.portal
.enter{color:var(--brass);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:900px){
.portal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.portal,.portal:nth-child(4n+2),.portal:nth-child(4n+3){grid-column:auto;min-height:320px}
}
/* branch mark — static, restrained */
.aperture{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.aperture
.ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--c);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.aperture .r1{stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:1 7;opacity:.3}
.aperture .r2{stroke-width:1.4;stroke-dasharray:60 14 6 14;opacity:.5}
.aperture .r3{stroke-width:.8;opacity:.22}
.aperture .iris{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;opacity:.35}
.aperture
.mono{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:38px;fill:var(--text);text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central}
/* branch transition: a measured wipe */
.iris-ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;pointer-events:none;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#EEEAE0;
background:linear-gradient(120deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c)
34%,#0A0A0B),#0A0A0B 62%);clip-path:circle(0 at var(--x) var(--y))}
.iris-ov.open{pointer-events:auto;clip-path:circle(150% at var(--x)
var(--y));transition:clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.iris-ov.out{opacity:0;transition:opacity .55s ease}
.iris-ov .il{opacity:0;transform:scale(.98);transition:opacity .5s
.3s,transform .8s .3s}
.iris-ov.open .il{opacity:1;transform:none}
.iris-ov .il
b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(50px,8vw,100px);letter-spacing:-.05em}
.iris-ov .il small{opacity:.7;font-size:15px}
/* subsidiary detail */
.back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:38px;color:var(--mute);text-decoration:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}
.back:hover{color:var(--text)}
.sub-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr)
minmax(260px,.7fr);gap:70px;align-items:center;min-height:560px;padding:clamp(72px,9vw,130px)
0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sub-hero
.ap-wrap{max-width:300px;width:100%;justify-self:center;opacity:.76;animation:fadeIn
1s ease both}
/* branch audience line: the inline branch color is replaced by brass so
the parent palette leads and every branch stays legible */
.sub-hero
p.lede[style*="color"]{color:var(--brass)!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:20px}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}}
@media
(max-width:820px){.sub-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;min-height:0}.sub-hero
.ap-wrap{max-width:200px;grid-row:1;justify-self:start}}
.offer-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr))}
.offer-list li{min-height:140px;padding:26px;background:var(--panel)}
.offer-list b{display:block;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px}

/*
==========================================================================
ABOUT / LEADERSHIP
==========================================================================
*/
.leaders{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr))}
.leaders>.person{padding:26px;background:var(--bg)}
.person
.shot{aspect-ratio:3/4;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px
solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,color-mix(in
srgb,var(--panel2)
74%,transparent),var(--panel));font-family:var(--serif);font-size:72px;color:var(--mute)}
.person dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px
14px;font-size:14px;margin:14px 0 0}
.person dt{color:var(--mute)}
.person dd{margin:0}
.timeline{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;border-left:1px solid
var(--brass)}
.timeline li{position:relative;padding:0 0 28px 28px}
.timeline
li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-6px;top:8px;width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--bg);border:2px
